evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat diagnostic register reproducing a failure carries low arousal and mildly negative valence — weariness of a known breakage, not alarm.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Repeated imperative 'must' conveys urgency-as-worry about failure modes — high arousal, negative valence directed at preventing breakage.
